**必须含【已报备的签名】**，通常放开头；70 字以内一条，超出按 67 字/: **Must include the [registered signature]**, usually at the start; up to 70 characters per message, longer messages are billed in 67-character segments
11 位号码；多个逗号分隔（单次上限 1 万）: 11-digit number; comma-separated for multiple (up to 10,000 per send)
全文发送：内容必须带已报备的短信签名（如【某某科技】），否则运营商直接拒收: Free-text send: the content must include the registered SMS signature (e.g. [Example Co.]), otherwise carriers reject it outright
发到境外号码：号码带国家码（如 +81…、+1…）。用凭证里的国际短信应用: For sending to overseas numbers: the number must include a country code (e.g. +81…, +1…). Uses the international SMS app in the credential
发送操作的产出；与手机号至少填一个: Output of a send operation; fill in either this or the phone number
国际短信按金额计费；没配国际应用时为 0: International SMS is billed by amount; shows 0 when no international app is configured
带国家码：+81xxx / +1xxx；多个逗号分隔: With country code: +81xxx / +1xxx; comma-separated for multiple
带国家码；多个逗号分隔: With country code; comma-separated for multiple
按 send_id 或手机号查下发结果：delivered=已送达，droppe: Check delivery results by send_id or phone number: delivered=delivered, dropped=rejected by the carrier (unregistered signature / content filtering / invalid number). If the send succeeded but the phone never got it, the answer is here
按已审核的国际短信模板发送：模板 ID + 变量: Send using an approved international SMS template: template ID + variables
按已审核的模板发送（验证码/通知类推荐）：给模板 ID + 变量: Send using an approved template (recommended for verification codes / notifications): template ID + variables

控制台「短信」应用的 AppID（纯数字）。只用国际短信可留空: The AppID of the "SMS" app in the console (digits only). Leave blank if you only use international SMS
控制台「短信模板」里的 项目标识（如 abc12）: The project identifier from "SMS Templates" in the console (e.g. abc12)
查短信余额：国内（条数）+ 国际（余额，按金额计费），配了哪组应用查哪边。余额告: Check SMS balance: domestic (message count) + international (balance, billed by amount) — only checks the app(s) you've configured. Useful for a balance-alert workflow: check on a schedule → notify when below a threshold
查这个号码最近的下发记录: Look up recent delivery records for this number
模板变量对象，键=模板里的 @var(键名)；原样传给 SUBMAIL: Template variables object, where keys match @var(key name) in the template; passed through to SUBMAIL as-is
每条含 send_id/to/status/report 等，形状由 SUBMA: Each entry has send_id/to/status/report etc., shaped as defined by SUBMAIL — status: delivered=delivered, dropped=rejected (the carrier's reason is in report), sending=in transit
没配国内应用时为 0: Shows 0 when no domestic app is configured
用配好的应用各查一次余额——appid/appkey 有误当场暴露: Checks the balance once for each configured app — a wrong appid/appkey is exposed immediately
